label: Rainfall / stormwater
definition: Rainfall accumulating or running off faster than drainage can remove it. Do not infer from a photograph alone.

label: Coastal storm surge
definition: Coastal water pushed onto land by a storm; requires supporting attribution.

label: Tidal flooding
definition: High-tide inundation independent of a required named storm.

label: River flooding
definition: A river or stream exceeding its channel capacity.

label: Groundwater flooding
definition: Water entering or rising above ground from a high water table.

label: Sewer backup
definition: Sewage or combined-sewer water backing into property.

label: Compound flooding
definition: An explicitly documented interaction of multiple flood mechanisms. Multiple tags alone do not prove interaction.

label: Mechanism not established
definition: Cause is absent, broad, or not established by the source; never interpret as no flood.

label: Understand risk
definition: Learn about hazards, history, observations, or evidence.

label: Prepare
definition: Plan or take precautions before an event.

label: Respond
definition: Find information or assistance during an event or its immediate effects.

label: Recover
definition: Repair, obtain support, or address impacts after an event.

label: Adapt
definition: Make longer-term changes to reduce exposure or vulnerability.

label: Preparedness
definition: Planning, supplies, and practical preparation.

label: Infrastructure
definition: Public systems and built works that affect flood management.

label: Planning and policy
definition: Policy frameworks, planning processes, and recommendations.

label: Risk maps
definition: Mapped hazard scenarios or explanatory mapping guidance.

label: Flood monitoring
definition: Sensors, measurement methods, and observations over time.

label: Flood impacts
definition: Reported or measured effects, including transportation and property disruption.

label: Housing
definition: Homes, living conditions, and housing support.

label: Community organizing
definition: Collective local participation in flood policy or action.

label: Building protection
definition: Property-level physical measures to reduce flood damage.

label: Drainage
definition: Sewers, catch basins, runoff conveyance, and storage.

label: Health
definition: Health impacts and health-related response or recovery resources.

label: Insurance
definition: Flood coverage information, counseling, and claim support.

label: Recovery
definition: Restoration and assistance after flood impacts.

label: Report a problem
definition: Channels to report conditions or damage; not an emergency response guarantee.

label: Transportation
definition: Roads, transit, tunnels, and travel disruption.

label: Legal assistance
definition: Legal information, referrals, or services; representation must be separately established.

label: Referrals and navigation
definition: Connecting a person to another provider or program.

label: Financial assistance
definition: Funding or financing; distinguish grants, loans, and insurance.

label: Relocation
definition: Moving from a flood-vulnerable or damaged home.

label: Alerts
definition: Subscriptions and notification services.

label: Training and events
definition: Preparedness education, workshops, and presentations.

label: Supplies
definition: Access to or instructions for physical preparedness materials.

label: Shelter
definition: Temporary shelter or referral after an emergency; a general program is not an open shelter.

label: Business recovery
definition: Recovery assistance intended for businesses or nonprofits.

label: Cleanup
definition: Post-flood cleaning, dewatering, or waste handling.

label: Public space
definition: Parks and other shared outdoor spaces.

label: Residents
definition: People living in an affected or relevant area.

label: Renters
definition: Tenants seeking housing or flood resources.

label: Homeowners
definition: Owners seeking resources for their homes.

label: Businesses
definition: Businesses and nonprofit operators.

label: Community groups
definition: Local organizations, organizers, and civic groups.

label: Researchers
definition: People analyzing flood evidence or methods.

label: Public agencies
definition: Government planning, operations, and service teams.

label: Listed; contact provider
definition: Service is documented online. Actual capacity and individual eligibility are unconfirmed.

label: Expression of interest
definition: An interest-collection route exists; it is not an assistance application.

label: Current intake unconfirmed
definition: Historical or ambiguous program information requires provider confirmation.

label: Request subject to capacity
definition: Requests may be submitted; fulfillment or scheduling is not established.

label: Depends on scheduled event
definition: Availability depends on an event date, registration, or inventory.

label: Deadline listed; verify eligibility
definition: A source gives a deadline. Declaration scope and actual intake still need checking.

label: Historical program
definition: Retained for history and excluded from current-help results.

label: Provider confirmed availability
definition: Requires dated direct provider confirmation, scope, and next-review date.

label: Temporarily unavailable
definition: Provider has documented temporary closure or pause.

label: Closed
definition: Provider has documented closure or expired enrollment.

label: Modeled scenario
definition: A simulation, prediction, or model output; not a direct observation.

label: Instrument observation
definition: Instrument measurements, subject to sensor location and quality limitations.

label: Impact analysis
definition: An analytical synthesis of impacts with its own method and limitations.

label: Photograph
definition: A source-described photo; capture location, date, and depiction require review.

label: Satellite explainer
definition: Satellite-based animation or explanatory video; resolution and narration constrain interpretation.

label: Historical map
definition: A map with time-specific information, not evidence of current services.

label: Instructional material
definition: Educational media demonstrating a process or equipment.
